high_level_description: This image captures a traditional Indian wedding ceremony. The setting appears to be outdoors, with a decorated backdrop featuring hanging floral garlands in shades of pink and white, suggesting a festive and celebratory atmosphere. In the foreground, there is a bride dressed in a vibrant green and gold saree adorned with intricate embroidery and embellishments. She is wearing a red blouse with gold detailing and a matching red and gold lehenga (a type of skirt). Her hair is styled with white flowers and she has a headpiece that complements her attire.
